verdict.rationale: Restate's docs explicitly describe idempotency-key deduplication and exactly-once processing for events/invocations (restate-docs-37, restate-docs-47, restate-docs-81), plus guaranteed exactly-once service calls (restate-docs-3) and durable step persistence/retry semantics (restate-docs-15, restate-docs-18, restate-docs-30) that together prevent duplicate side effects like double-charging or double-sending. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of idempotency-key deduplication behavior in production (community evidence is about general product experience, not this feature).
